content.title: Implement webapp port configuration changes
content.description:
Apply the planned port changes:
- server/index.ts: default PORT 3000 -> 3001.
- frontend/vite.config.ts: apiPort default '3000' -> '3001'; dev vite default port 3000 when VITE_PORT unset (E2E overrides with 5000).
- playwright.config.ts: API webServer 3001 -> 5001, vite 5174 -> 5000, baseURL -> http://localhost:5000, update env vars (PORT=5001, VITE_PORT=5000, API_PORT=5001) and the port comment.
- Update package.json scripts, docs, and expertise files that reference old ports.

Verify dev server boots on 3001 and vite on 3000; verify E2E config points at 5001/5000.

content.reason: Blocker issue mqh2hw1wl3 transitioned to done

content.content: Done. Implemented all webapp port configuration changes per the approved prescription (comment mqh2nfnt2o). Standardized webapp ports: dev API defaults to 3001, dev vite to 3000, E2E uses 5001 (API) and 5000 (vite). Pure infrastructure config, no user-facing change.

Changes made - Config files (section A): server index.ts PORT default 3000 to 3001; frontend vite.config.ts apiPort default 3000 to 3001 and vitePort now defaults to 3000 when VITE_PORT unset (was undefined falling back to 5173), strictPort preserved; playwright.config.ts backend webServer 3001 to 5001, vite webServer 5174 to 5000, baseURL to localhost 5000, header comment updated.

E2E spec files (section B, the 63 inline URLs missed by the parent prescription): phase3, phase4, dashboard-roots, url-filters each had their BASE constant updated 3001 to 5001; phase1 got a new BASE const replacing 3 inline health URLs; phase2 had all 60 inline localhost-3001 occurrences replaced with localhost-5001.

Verification - Frontend typecheck and build (tsc plus vite build) passes. No lint script exists in the webapp (confirmed). Playwright test list: all 176 tests across 6 files load cleanly; config and all specs parse with the new ports. Dev sanity check: backend logs Server running on localhost 3001, vite logs localhost 3000, health endpoint returns 200 on 3001, both dev ports verified responding. E2E backend: started with PORT 5001 and AGENTRACK_CWD isolation, confirmed it binds 5001 and health returns 200.

Caveats - Full E2E run could not be completed in this environment because port 5000 is occupied by the macOS AirPlay Receiver (ControlCenter process), which blocks the Playwright vite webServer. This is an environment constraint, not a code issue. The validator (mqh2hwglif) should run the suite where 5000 is free or temporarily disable AirPlay Receiver. I could not update the spec, roadmap, or expertise docs (section D of the prescription) because those folders are read-only or outside my domain. Filed idea mqh326adbp for those doc updates, assigned to project-manager for triage.

Reassigning to project-manager for review.
